1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.

10: export function projectType(root) {
11:   if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
12:     const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
13:     if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')

21:   const type = projectType(root)
22:   const projectRoot = resolve(root)
23:   if (type === 'vite') {
24:     const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
25:     mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
26:     const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
27:     const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
28:     const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
29:     let old = ''
30:     try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
31:     if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
32:       await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
33:       mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
34:       const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
35:       writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
36:     }
37:     await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
38:     root = join(root, 'dist')
39:   }
40:   if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
41:   if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
42:   const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
43:   const clients = new Set()
44:   const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
45:   const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
46:   const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
47:   const server = createServer((req, res) => {
48:     try {
49:       const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
50:       if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
51:         res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
52:         res.write(': connected\n\n')
53:         clients.add(res)
54:         req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
55:         return
56:       }
57:       const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
58:       if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
59:       const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
60:       res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
61:       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
62:       const content = readFileSync(file)
63:       if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
64:         const html = content.toString()
65:         res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
66:       } else res.end(content)
67:     } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
68:   })
69:   server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
70:   server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
71:   return server
